newsitem.title: YEMEN: Britain's Rifkind arrives in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Rifkind arrives in Yemen.

text.p: British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind arrived in Yemen on Tuesday on the last leg of a regional tour of the Middle East.
He arrived in the Yemeni capital Sanaa from Abu Dhabi, where he launched the idea of a new Middle East body designed to encourage regional cooperation and prevent escalation of conflicts.
Rifkind told a news conference in Abu Dhabi that reaction to the proposal had been encouraging but that the project was still in a very early stage.
He was due to hold talks with Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh and Prime Minister Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani before returning home on Wednesday.
Yemen's economy, hit by a brief civil war in 1994, is slowly improving under IMF-agreed economic reforms.
British officials see Yemen, which has a population of 16 million, as a potentianl future market for British firms.
Rifkind has already met Israeli and Palestinian leaders and Jordan's King Hussein during his tour to discuss the Arab-Israeli peace process.
